ops.title: hermes container-native cutover: DONE + operational gotchas (2026-07-18)
ops.body:
The tart→apple/container hermes migration is FUNCTIONALLY LIVE as of 2026-07-18. See [[apple/container virtiofs idmap: uid model for hermes-agent OCI]] (ca8ac58f) for the idmap fix.

## Live state (all green)
- Container `hermes` (apple/container, image digest 43d885a7) runs the agent as uid1000+group0 on the fixed entrypoint (chown removed, group-0 in the setpriv drop).
- Joined the tailnet as the canonical **hermes** (100.126.207.80) after the identity handoff.
- **metal (model plane) reachable**: container→metal 8000/8317/8765/14322 all OPEN.
- **BlueBubbles webhook LISTENING** on hermes.tail71af5d.ts.net:8645 (the container's tailnet IP).
- Proxy 403 canary passes with the correct creds (setpriv uid1000/gid1000/+group0).

## The identity handoff was the key (name-driven fleet)
metal's pf gate (darwin/metal.nix:317) and the BlueBubbles webhook BOTH resolve **hermes by name** (`tailscale ip -4 hermes`). Freeing the name for the container fixed both at once — NO ACL edit needed (the tag:hermes→tag:metal grant already existed). Steps: renamed tart device→hermes-old (id 5275104086060092, PARKED for rollback), container→hermes (id 6345358681811692) via `/api/v2/device/<id>/name` using the repo `.env` TAILSCALE_API_KEY (valid); then kicked `org.nixos.metal-pf-refresh` on metal (root over tailscale ssh) so its sticky anchor re-resolved to the container IP.

## GOTCHAS (operational)
1. **Expired sops authkey**: the tailscale authkey in ~/.yclaw/state/hosts/hermes/secrets.sops.yaml had expired (~90d). Minted a fresh reusable preauthorized tag:hermes key (id k4eJgfYqwP11CNTRL, exp 2026-10-16) via the console API and `sops set` it into the STAGED bundle only. The CANONICAL bundle (~/.yclaw/state/secrets.sops.yaml, if it carries tailscale.authkey) was NOT updated — a `setup.sh host-container` re-run RE-STAGES secrets and would REVERT the staged authkey to the expired one. Update the canonical before any setup.sh re-run.
2. **Stale installed canary tick**: /usr/local/lib/yclaw/container-hermes.sh still has the OLD canary (`exec --user 1000:1000`, no group 0) → EACCES → rc=2 WARN → the doctor marker (container-hermes.last-ok) is never written. The group-0 fix is committed in the repo source (scripts/host/container-hermes.sh:61) but needs re-install. Harmless (WARN-only, never force-removes); the agent works. Reinstall the tick WITHOUT a full setup.sh re-run (which reverts the authkey per #1) — or update the canonical bundle first.

## Remaining
- Reinstall the fixed canary tick (safely, per gotcha #1).
- e2e: real iMessage → inference → reply (infra is green).
- Delete hermes-old after a soak (user approved "get rid entirely"; parked as rollback for now — its authkey is expired so restart-rollback needs the node record intact).
- Phase 5 records/docs; retire nixos/hermes.nix as the tart runner.
